scope: Mechanism and training-pipeline pilot, not a formal EventVLA experiment
environment_rule: After memory intervention, lifting an armed cover by more than 0.04 m resets its indicator to grey. Latches are disarmed before recovery.
action_source: One frozen offline-calibrated motor library; no per-evaluation expert planning
proposed_action_input: 16 equally spaced samples of actual motor drive targets
evidence: Four independent RGB color observations in a seed-shuffled order
split_unit: All actions and branches from a color/order family; geometry is shared across all families
recovery_permission: Both K and R can call the same frozen RGB/proprioceptive recovery controller
prefix_validation: Exact physical trace, current RGB/proprioception, evidence RGB hashes and RNG state
continuation_validation: K/R identical physical action completion and latch events, repeated R
capacity_evaluation: Common four-image prefix followed by one-shot compression to one retained image before action; not a continuously one-image online budget
